packageRules.description: A harness bump changes what the adapters parse, which CI cannot check without credentials
prBodyNotes: Before merging: re-record `packages/harness-{{depName}}/fixtures/` from the new release, and run the gated live test, `MAESTRO_PI=1` or `MAESTRO_CLAUDE=1 bun test packages/cli/src/repo.test.ts`.
